claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu calls someone a starseed if they are human on Earth after a recent life as another extraterrestrial species.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Broadly, she says every soul is a starseed.

claims.assertion: She distinguishes memories of advanced off-world societies from memories of higher astral realms.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Either may cause a sense of not belonging on Earth.

claims.assertion: She says extraction to another planet may not resolve a starseed’s problems.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: That world remains material; the desired idyll belongs to astral afterlife realms.
